title: Locality Administrator
company: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
description: Open only to applicants from Hampshire & Isle of Wight NHS system, which is limited to; Hampshire IOW Healthcare NHS Trust, Hampshire and Isle of Wight ICB, Portsmouth Hospitals University NHS Trust, Isle of Wight NHS Trust, University Hospital Southampton Foundation Trust, South Central Ambulance Service or Hampshire Hospitals Foundation Trust. An exciting opportunity has arisen for an enthusiastic, committed and well-motivated Locality Administrator to join the Community Nursing and CIS Team based at Royal South Hants Hospital in Southampton. The Locality Administrator role is a pivotal part of the Service, supporting both the administrative and clinical teams across Southampton City. You will need to possess strong prioritising and excellent organisational skills together with the ability to remain calm in a busy and dynamic environment. The work is varied, challenging and fast paced which requires a flexible approach. We are looking for someone that has experience in working in a team. You need to be able to demonstrate strong communication skills, be organised and possess good IT skills, including competence with Microsoft Office. Experience of System One is desirable although all training will be provided. The successful applicant must be flexible, should possess excellent time management skills, be self-motivated and have a positive attitude with a customer focused approach. The role is full time based on 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Our core hours are 08:30 to 16:30. To provide comprehensive administrative support to the service. To work as part of a skill mix team to provide a comprehensive administrative support service. To effectively prioritise and manage own workload and oversee workload of team as necessary, whilst maintaining confidentiality and diplomacy at all times, both independently and as part of a team. To work without direct supervision and show extensive use of initiative in prioritising and making decisions in relation to effectively supporting the smooth operation of the service. To carry out other duties as necessary to meet the changing needs of HIOW Healthcare NHS Trust, accordance with management requirements and appropriate to banding. All duties will be carried out within the Trusts Information Governance, recording, and data sharing procedures and guidance. Further information about the Trust and this role can be found on the Job Description and Person Specification document attached. It is important to us that we ensure our recruitment processes are accessible and inclusive to everyone - if as a potential candidate you are concerned a person specification may prevent or restrict your application for employment as a result of unintentional barriers on the grounds of your sex, race, age, sexual orientation, religion/belief or disability please initially contact the Trust's Recruitment team - detailed in the advert. The Trust will seek to resolve this issue wherever possible. We are happy to talk Flexible Working - all requests for flexible working options can be discussed as part of the interview process.

title: UEL Business Administrator
description: We are delighted to offer an exciting opportunity to join our team at UHS Estates Ltd (UEL). Please refer to the detailed job description below for more information about the role. The position provides comprehensive administrative support to ensure the efficient, effective, and customer-focused delivery of services across UEL. The role is responsible for coordinating day-to-day administrative activities, maintaining accurate records, supporting meetings, rostering and reporting, and working collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders to continuously improve administrative processes and service delivery. Key responsibilities include maintaining accurate electronic records, coordinating meetings and staff rostering, processing data, assisting with reporting, and providing comprehensive administrative support to the wider team. The postholder will also contribute to the development and continuous improvement of administrative processes, promoting efficient ways of working and supporting service excellence. Working closely with managers, colleagues, and key stakeholders, the postholder will help ensure services are responsive, well organised, and delivered to a consistently high standard. We are looking for a motivated person with excellent organisational and communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to prioritise and manage competing demands while maintaining confidentiality and delivering exceptional customer service. The ideal candidate should have the ability to travel or a driving licence to facilitate supporting staff and managers across multiple sites that UEL covers key sites being; Hampshire Orthopaedic Centre, Adanac park and our larger site, Southampton General Hospital.

title: Registration Authority Administrator
company: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking for a motivated individual to join our Smartcard team. The post holder will be responsible for delivering the duties associated with the issuing and processing of ID badges and Smartcards as a business as usual function by providing an efficient, helpful and supportive services to all managers, staff and where applicable external organisations. This includes the registering of staff for Smartcards ensuring that they are compliant with GDPR requirements and standards outlined by Connecting for Health, and that cards are processed in a timely manner. They will be expected to support RA Agents in Trust with Smartcard issues and to be an additional point of contact to the Trust's central RA function. The post holder will be expected to manage their own workload on a day to day basis; training and supervision will be provided by the RA Coordinator. At present, the Trust is unable to offer Skilled Worker visa sponsorship for this post. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. The post holder will be required to assist the Registration Authority (RA) Coordinator with the following duties. These will be performed under supervision and thorough training will be provided. *Register staff for Smartcards and take photographs where necessary *Process RA requests in User Identity Manager (UIM) *Print Smartcards and post Smartcards *Maintain a log of issued Smartcards and ensure Smartcards are received on time *Attend to RA queries via phone or email *Liaise with other departments to follow up on urgent access queries *Regularly update the Trust's list of RA Agents and Smartcard Unlockers *Receive leavers' Smartcards for cancelling *Follow up leavers and deactivate access *Follow up with users to ensure that each user only has 1 Smartcard *Follow up expired Smartcards and ensure cards are renewed or cancelled accordingly *Where necessary Synchronise users in both Mental Health and Community RiO Systems *Liaise with other departments to arrange Smartcard registration of groups of students and junior doctors *Schedule RA Agent training on behalf of the RA Coordinator *Ensure user details in CIM and the Electronic Staff Record (ESR) are consistent. Further information about the Trust and this role can be found on the Job Description and Person Specification document attached. It is important to us that we ensure our recruitment processes are accessible and inclusive to everyone - if as a potential candidate you are concerned a person specification may prevent or restrict your application for employment as a result of unintentional barriers on the grounds of your sex, race, age, sexual orientation, religion/belief or disability please initially contact the Trust's Recruitment team - detailed in the advert. The Trust will seek to resolve this issue wherever possible. We are happy to talk Flexible Working - all requests for flexible working options can be discussed as part of the interview process.
